decisions.reason: Given its dedicated webpage and building on the established offer, Product A shows high visible commitment and centrality, so escalation of commitment makes dropping very unlikely.
Product B builds on the established offer and its early results can still be attributed to temporary causes, so management tends to persist despite only a website mention.
Product C is close to the established offer but has only a website mention, lowering visibility, yet sunk costs and public commitment still make a drop less likely.
Product D's open development framework aligns with the firm's announced open, extensible direction, and its early results can be seen as temporary, so it is likely kept.
Product E's public launch quote and closeness to the established offer signal visible commitment that management will justify by keeping it.
